sources.title: 👹 TEEMO THE MID LANE MENACE — THE DEFINITIVE GUIDE 👹

passive.name: Guerrilla Warfare
passive.text: If Teemo stands still and takes no actions for a short duration, he becomes Invisible indefinitely. If he's in brush, Teemo can enter and maintain his Invisibility while moving. After leaving Invisibility, Teemo gains the Element of Surprise, increasing his Attack Speed for a few seconds.

spells.name: Blinding Dart
spells.text: Obscures an enemy's vision with a powerful venom, dealing damage to the target unit and blinding it for the duration.

spells.name: Move Quick
spells.text: Teemo scampers around, passively increasing his Move Speed until he is struck by an enemy champion or turret. Teemo can sprint to gain bonus Move Speed that isn't stopped by being struck for a short time.

spells.name: Toxic Shot
spells.text: Each of Teemo's attacks will poison the target %i:OnHit% On-Hit, dealing damage on impact and each second after for 4 seconds.

spells.name: Noxious Trap
spells.text: Teemo throws an explosive poisonous trap using one of the mushrooms stored in his pack. If an enemy steps on the trap, it will release a poisonous cloud, slowing enemies and damaging them over time. If Teemo throws a mushroom onto another mushroom it will bounce, gaining additional range.

damage.value: Teemo deals direct damage with Blinding Dart and sustained poison damage with Toxic Shot and Noxious Trap.

axis.value: Teemo clears the wave, pokes before committing, and moves only when the movement has a clear purpose.

winCondition.value: Teemo wins by clearing safely, disappearing from vision, and controlling entrances and objectives with mushrooms.

spikes.why: Teemo can clear without constantly spending mana or staying exposed, creating time to move and set up mushrooms.
Teemo gains increased Attack Speed for a few seconds.

bait.why: Teemo cannot blind a target again until Blinding Dart’s 7-second cooldown ends.

mistakes.value: Teemo gives up too much when he sacrifices a wave for a move without a clear purpose.
Teemo delays Invisibility by moving or taking an action outside brush.
